title: Morning Brief — Friday, 13 November 2026
description: Australian households continue to see electricity price relief under the latest default market offer, land is secured in Rockhampton for a new Queensland Academy for Health Sciences, and the Gold Coast Convention Centre reaffirms its economic impact. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
